visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with reddish-brown hair tied back in a bun sits on a brown textured sofa in a brightly lit indoor room. She is wearing a grey knit cardigan decorated with bows over a black top and a black skirt. She holds a small red book and speaks directly to the camera with animated facial expressions. (2) She rests her hands on the red book while closing her eyes in a focused manner. Digitally added white smoke and sparkling light particles emanate from the book and her hands. (3) She flips the book open to a random page. She immediately begins laughing hysterically with her mouth wide open and head thrown back. Images of various luxury leather handbags in different colors are overlaid across her torso. (4) The woman continues speaking to the camera, gesturing with her hands. Cartoon avatars of two young boys appear beside her with labels identifying them as her sons. She shows the open pages of the book, which contain Chinese and English text. (5) A movie clip from an old Chinese film is briefly inserted, showing a white-bearded man and another younger man. The video cuts back to the woman who holds the red book and smiles warmly at the camera while delivering her final remarks.
